description: This file defines a JavaScript module for interacting with Vtiger CRM web services, including functions for login, logout, CRUD operations, and session management.

classes.name: VtigerWebservices
classes.description: Constructor function for VtigerWebservices object, initializes service URL, username, and access key.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by obtaining a challenge token and then authenticating with encoded access key.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out of the web service session.

methods.name: listTypes
methods.description: Retrieves list of object types from the CRM.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an object record by ID.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes an object record by ID.
